in_marathi.name: Dwarakaa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Dwarka
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dwarakaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dwarakaa is a name of the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, fortune, and prosperity in Hindu mythology. She is the consort of Lord Vishnu and is particularly revered in the city of Dwarka. Dwarakaa is believed to bestow her blessings upon her devotees, bringing them wealth, happiness, and prosperity.
